title.zh: Perplexity开源SPACE：给AI完整root权限，却把密钥留在虚拟机外
title.en: Perplexity开源SPACE：给AI完整root权限，却把密钥留在虚拟机外

current_state.zh: Perplexity open-sourced SPACE, the Apache 2.0-licensed Firecracker-based sandbox platform that gives AI agents full root inside isolated microVMs while keeping API keys and network egress outside the VM, now handling millions of agent sandboxes per day with ~3x lower creation latency.
